short.bowl: white ceramic bowl with geometric design

global: A bowl of tonkotsu ramen features a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and vibrant green scallions. Served in a white bowl with blue geometric trim, it rests on a pink surface under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: The surface is a smooth, solid pinkish-red with subtle texture variations and faint white text visible along its edge.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with blue geometric pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, thinly sliced, light brown meat with glossy surface and faint marbling.
